rows.label: bf03220100_0010
rows.name: Oh, you guys. What's up this early?

rows.label: bf03220100_0020
rows.name: Nia?

rows.label: bf03220100_0030
rows.name:
You were a big help yesterday.
I'm glad you were there.

rows.label: bf03220100_0040
rows.name:
That guy, Yoshitsune, I mean... I wanted
to tell you about him, you see...

rows.label: bf03220100_0050
rows.name: Thing is, we used to be...

rows.label: bf03220100_0060
rows.name:
Being a mercenary... You
meet all different folks.

rows.label: bf03220100_0070
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]え？

rows.label: bf03220100_0080
rows.name:
Your country, family, money... People
got plenty of reasons to fight.

rows.label: bf03220100_0090
rows.name:
Some even have strange crystals in
their chests and say it's for her.

rows.label: bf03220100_0100
rows.name: M-me? N-no, I'm just—

rows.label: bf03220100_0110
rows.name:
Nia, you're with these guys
right now. That's what matters.

rows.label: bf03220100_0120
rows.name: Vandham— you...

rows.label: bf03220100_0130
rows.name:
Anyway. Rex, weren't you saying
you wanted to get to Eden?

rows.label: bf03220100_0140
rows.name: Yeah... But we hit a snag...

rows.label: bf03220100_0150
rows.name:
With something like that near the World Tree,
nobody can get close.

rows.label: bf03220100_0160
rows.name:
If we tried crossing in a Trading Company airship,
it'd probably get shot down.

rows.label: bf03220100_0170
rows.name:
I have an old acquaintance
in Invidia's royal capital.

rows.label: bf03220100_0180
rows.name:
Got a feeling he might
know a way through.

rows.label: bf03220100_0190
rows.name: Really?!

rows.label: bf03220100_0200
rows.name:
Yeah. I gotta go there anyhow.
So I could introduce you.

rows.label: bf03220100_0210
rows.name: Vandham-san! Thank you!

rows.label: bf03220100_0220
rows.name:
Nah! It's destiny or
something. Don't sweat it.

rows.label: bf03220100_0230
rows.name:
Get your stuff together and meet
me by the village entrance.
